## 2. Usability Assessment

Scores use High / Medium / Low. Confidence reflects how directly the supplied artifact supports the assessment.

| Criterion | Score | Rationale | Confidence | Evidence | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Relevance | High | Contains wind-energy infrastructure and locations relevant to offshore wind context and spatial modeling. | High | 292 features, including generators, substations, plants, and wind-farm areas. | OSM tagging does not guarantee every relevant object is included. |
| Representativeness | Medium | Represents the supplied dated snapshot, but regional completeness cannot be established. | Low | Source note provides a broad geographic description only. | Exact bbox, query, and selection criteria are absent. |
| Reliability | Medium | OSM element IDs, tags, contributor attribution, and ODbL provide traceability; data are community edited rather than an official inventory. | Medium | Raw IDs and tag dictionaries are retained. | No independent verification of individual features or status. |
| Temporal validity | Medium | The snapshot is dated, but the date is not an observation or commissioning date and does not establish current operational status. | Medium | Snapshot date 2026-10-27; only 103 of 292 features have a `status` tag. | No retrieval time, edit history snapshot, or per-feature validity interval in this extract. |
| Ingestability | High | GeoJSON is straightforward to parse and has a small, explicit set of structural properties. | High | FeatureCollection; 287 Point, 4 Polygon, and 1 null geometry. | Mixed OSM element types, arbitrary nested tags, and null geometry need handling. |
| Reuse in a digital-twin workflow | Medium | Useful for spatial context after preserving original tags and applying cautious mappings. | Medium | IDs, geometry, all tags, members, license, and attribution can be carried through. | Not suitable as an authoritative inventory or for inferring absent attributes. |
| Attribute completeness | Low–Medium | Raw OSM tags carry detail where supplied but many features have sparse attributes. | High | Only 103 features contain `status`; 32 distinct tag keys occur in this snapshot. | Units and classifications vary or are absent; values must not be guessed. |

### 2.1 Overall assessment

The snapshot is ingestible and useful as a dated, traceable spatial context layer. Its regional completeness and feature-level accuracy are not demonstrated, so it should not be treated as a national inventory or as ground truth for operational status. Preserve source tags and identifiers, distinguish source facts from harmonized fields, and report missing values rather than infer them.

## 3. Field Provenance Classification

### Source fields

The source-level collection fields are `type`, `source`, and `features`. Each feature carries `id`, `type`, `geometry`, and `properties`; the source properties are `osm_type`, `osm_id`, `tags`, and, for the relation, `members`. `tags` contains 32 distinct observed keys across the snapshot. These values are preserved without renaming or normalization in the source-data block.

### Derived or resolved fields

BB2 adds target-facing properties only when an explicit OSM tag supports the mapping. The source fields remain alongside them:

| Source field | Target property | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| `tags.name`, otherwise `tags.seamark:name` | `name` | Copy the first available name. |
| `tags.plant:output:electricity`, otherwise `tags.generator:output:electricity` | `power_mw` | Parse only numeric values explicitly expressed in MW; retain the raw tag. |
| `tags.status` | `status` | Copy text without status-category normalization. |
| `tags.plant:type` | `type_inst` | Copy the explicit source value. |
| `tags.start_date` | `year` | Copy the source string; retain the original tag because its date semantics are not further resolved. |
| `tags.turbines` | `n_turbines` | Parse only a whole-number count. |
| Explicit wind-farm area tags | `category_of_offshore_production_area` | Add IHO Registry item 42 code `1` only when source tags support an area classification. |
| Explicit `generator:method=wind_turbine` on a point, or supported wind-farm area tags | `iho_feature_role` | Link to a local IHO-aligned concept; does not assert S-101 conformance. |

No source-to-target mapping is defined for `country`, `dist_coast`, `notes`, `updateyear`, or `area_sqkm`; there is no defensible per-feature evidence for these fields in the snapshot.

### Synthetic enrichment fields

No feature-level synthetic enrichment is added. The catalog record contains computed summary metadata: feature and geometry counts, a bbox derived from available geometries, and calendar-day bounds derived from the date-only snapshot date. These are catalog-level summaries, not observations or source feature properties. `datetime` is null because the source only supports a date, not a retrieval timestamp.

The user selected the base EMODnet-compliant windfarm block as the target and requested a new extension, not the PL extension. The extension preserves OSM data and adds only explicit mappings. |

IHO terminology was used only where the source explicitly identifies wind turbines or wind-farm areas; local terms cite IHO registry and S-101/S-32 references rather than minting unsupported IHO identifiers.

## 5a. Transform: BB1 → BB2

The Python transform at `_sources/_staging/emodnet-windfarm-osm/transforms/to_emodnet_windfarm.py` is used because several source tags require conditional parsing and the output must preserve an entire FeatureCollection and nested source properties.

| Source field | Target field | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Collection `source`, feature `id`, `type`, `geometry`, all original `properties` | Same source fields in output | Shallow-copy at each level; original values and tag dictionary are retained. |
| `tags.name` / `tags.seamark:name` | `name` | First available name. |
| Electricity-output tag ending in explicit MW | `power_mw` | Numeric conversion only for explicit MW units and parseable number. |
| `tags.status` | `status` | Verbatim. |
| `tags.plant:type` | `type_inst` | Verbatim. |
| `tags.start_date` | `year` | Verbatim; raw tag remains. |
| `tags.turbines` | `n_turbines` | Whole number only. |
| Explicit wind-farm area tags | `category_of_offshore_production_area=1`, `iho_feature_role` | IHO code and local linked concept only with source evidence. |
| `tags.generator:method=wind_turbine` | `iho_feature_role` | Local IHO-aligned turbine concept. |

**Excluded source fields:** none. All source properties remain in output; source values that do not meet a conditional mapping remain available in `tags`. The explicitly unmapped EMODnet targets are absent rather than fabricated.

**Local regression result: PASS.** The test checks all 292 source features and asserts preservation of collection keys, feature IDs/types/geometries, original properties, tags, and relation members, plus expected harmonized fields and IHO classifications. The generator also reported Draft 2020-12 schema/example validation, Python syntax validation, and Turtle parsing as passing. Container-based validation is reported separately below.

## 7. Identified Metadata Gaps

| Gap | Severity | Resolution / consequence |
|---|---|---|
| Original OSM API response body, bbox, exact request URL, query, and selection criteria are absent. | Medium | The source block preserves the supplied GeoJSON artifact as received and does not fabricate an acquisition/reconstruction path. Regional completeness remains unknown; future response parsing must be described as a separate transformation. |
| Snapshot date has no time of day or immutable OSM database state identifier. | Medium | Catalog uses date precision, null datetime, and clearly labeled calendar-day bounds. No exact retrieval time is asserted. |
| OSM `status` is missing from most features and is not normalized. | Medium | Preserve only supplied status values; downstream users should not interpret absence as planned, operational, or decommissioned. |
| OSM classification/unit conventions may be incomplete or inconsistent. | Medium | Transform maps only explicit supported values; ambiguous/unparseable values remain in raw tags. |
| Catalog asset href targets the repository's `main` branch. | Low | Replace with a versioned release or immutable commit URL when the data snapshot is published. |
| Full container post-processing validation | Medium | The first run identified and the generator corrected invalid BB3 compact-IRI term mappings. Local Draft 2020-12 schema/example checks, JSON-LD expansion checks, Turtle parsing, and the transform regression pass.
